text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How lovely...! So quiet and relaxing. 
To think a cafe like this existed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty of time until 
training. 
I'll just take it easy here for a little 
while—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is... from that jazz album 
Mother used to listen to all the time...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: There's still time, just a little longer—

Lost in memories of her mother while 
listening to jazz, 
Daring Tact ended up skipping training 
entirely.
